map.总损失时间 L = Σ(各相位黄灯 + 全红时间)；总流量比 Y = Σ(各相位: Total lost time L = Σ(yellow + all-red of each phase); total flow ratio Y = Σ(y of each phase, where y = flow of that phase ÷ saturation flow); Webster optimal cycle C₀ = (1.5L + 5) ÷ (1 − Y); available green = C − L; green per phase g = available green × y ÷ Y. Y must be less than 1, otherwise there is no cycle solution (the approach is oversaturated).
map.两相位，黄灯各 3 s、全红各 2 s → L = 10 s；两相位 y 分别为: Two phases with 3 s yellow and 2 s all-red each → L = 10 s; the two phases have y of 0.30 and 0.25 → Y = 0.55. Webster cycle = (1.5×10+5)/(1−0.55) = 20/0.45 ≈ 44 s (in practice it is rounded and raised to around 60 s subject to the minimum cycle constraint). If the cycle is 90 s: available green = 80 s, phase one green = 80×0.30/0.55 ≈ 43.6 s, phase two ≈ 36.4 s.
map.Y 越接近 1 说明交叉口越接近饱和，Webster 公式分母趋零、算出周期急剧: The closer Y is to 1, the closer the intersection is to saturation; the denominator of the Webster formula approaches zero and the computed cycle grows sharply. In practice this can no longer be solved by timing alone and requires widening approaches or diverting traffic.
map.按各相位流量比占总流量比的权重分配，可使各相位饱和度大致相等，避免出现“一个方向: Allocating by each phase's flow ratio as a share of the total flow ratio makes saturation roughly equal across phases, avoiding unbalanced timing where one direction gets a long green while another keeps queueing.
map.采用 Webster 最佳周期公式 C₀ = (1.5L + 5) / (1 −: The Webster optimal cycle formula C₀ = (1.5L + 5) / (1 − Y) is used, where L is total lost time and Y is the sum of phase flow ratios
map.有效绿灯按 yᵢ / Y 比例分配：gᵢ = (C − L) × yᵢ / Y: Effective green is allocated in proportion yᵢ / Y: gᵢ = (C − L) × yᵢ / Y
map.流量比 y = 到达流量 q / 饱和流量 s，需 ≤ 1；Y > 0.9 时交: Flow ratio y = arrival flow q / saturation flow s, and must be ≤ 1; when Y > 0.9 the intersection approaches saturation
